Keys.TableHint: Opens or brings the Table of Souls to front.

Error.Action: Cuentos de Ánimas: the action could not be completed. Check the console (F12).

Settings.OpenOnStartHint: This browser only. Off by default: the Table never opens by itself unless you ask.
Settings.GrayVariantHint: Classic: each Grey Lady closes her third. Unpredictable: each Grey Lady is shuffled within her third.
Settings.AutoDiaryHint: Writes every card, result, truth and epilogue into the protagonist's diary.

Mode.guardianHint: One protagonist and one Guardian. Questions, truths and memories.
Mode.bonfireHint: Traditional table: several voices around the fire.
Mode.diaryHint: Solo play, writing the story scene by scene.
Mode.freeHint: The cards as a story engine, no fixed scenario.

Table.NextScene: The next scene waits face down.
Table.EmptyHook: Choose a scenario, a protagonist and light the first candle.
Table.FootIdle: Press “New story” or open the Library to pick a scenario.
Table.EndConfirm: The story closes and the table falls silent. The protagonist's diary and truths are kept.

Game.PendingObstacle: Resolve the obstacle on the table first.
Game.PendingGray: The Grey Lady still waits for her price.
Game.StoryClosing: The story is heading to its epilogue.
Game.EmptyDeck: The Deck of Souls is empty.
Game.NoObstacle: There is no obstacle to resolve.
Game.GrayCrosses: Something crosses the room. Pay her price: spend Resolve or lose Spirit.
Game.EpilogueReady: The third Lady has come. The story asks for its ending.

Epilogue.highHint: The protagonist keeps 2 or more Spirit.

Session.SplitHint: Ten points between Spirit and Resolve, at least three in each.
Session.Replaces: A story is running: starting another rebuilds the deck.
Session.GMOnly: Only the Guardian can start a story.
Session.BadSplit: The split must add up to 10, with at least 3 in each resource.

Actor.Name: Name
Actor.TraitText: What it means, when it weighs…
Actor.BondText: What binds you, what parts you
Actor.SplitNote: Maximum Spirit and Resolve do not add up to 10: fine if the scenario asks for it.

Diary.Placeholder: Write what happened, what you felt, what you did not say…
Diary.Empty: The diary is blank. Every card drawn will leave a mark here.
Diary.NoHistory: The chronicle starts with the first card.

Archive.Kicker: What was said and what is remembered

Truth.Placeholder: “I never spoke to my brother again after that night.”

Memory.Launch: Ask one of the scenario's questions
Memory.Placeholder: Do you remember it, or would you rather not?

Guardian.GrayNext: The next card will be a Grey Lady.
Guardian.NoGrayLeft: No Ladies left in the deck.
Guardian.RebuildConfirm: The whole deck is prepared again and the Ladies start over. The protagonist's resources do not change.

Scenario.Author: Author
Scenario.TensionHint: The story's scenes in rising order of tension. The Guardian walks them from their tool.
Scenario.TruthsHint: Statements the story will test, and what contradicts them. Only the Guardian sees the contradiction.
Scenario.SoundHint: A synthesized ambience for each moment, or the path to your own audio file.
Scenario.NotActive: This scenario is not in play.

Import.NotJSON: the file is not valid JSON.
Import.NotScenario: the file does not contain a scenario.

Safety.Intro: Anyone can use these at any time, without explaining why.
Safety.PauseText: Someone asked for a pause. We breathe and carry on when we are ready.
Safety.VeilHint: Fade to black: it happens, but is not described.
Safety.VeilText: This part happens off screen. The story continues afterwards.
Safety.XHint: This leaves the story. No questions.
Safety.XText: Someone touched the X-Card. We take back the last thing and go another way.
Safety.Anonymous: The signal never says who used it.

Access.Title: Reading & accessibility
Access.Intro: Settings just for you: size, contrast, motion and sound.
Access.readingModeHint: Plain backgrounds and light text on dark.
Access.wideSpacingHint: More room between lines and letters.
Access.richHelpHint: Notes when you rest on an element; right-click for more.
Access.Forgotten: Windows will return to their default position when opened.

Diagnostic.Title: Diagnostics
Diagnostic.Hint: System status, ready to copy and send if something fails.

Welcome.Title: MR · Cuentos de Ánimas
Welcome.Body: The Table of Souls never opens by itself: find it in the left toolbar (moon), in the directories, or with Shift+M.

spirit.Title: Spirit
spirit.Short: Your balance. Lost when failing an obstacle or facing a Grey Lady.
spirit.Long: The cold stones are Spirit. When one goes out, the story grows colder. If all go out, the story heads straight to its darkest epilogue.

determination.Title: Resolve
determination.Short: Your will. Spend it to tilt an obstacle your way.
determination.Long: Before revealing the number card it adds +2; afterwards, +1 if that is enough. From the second Grey Lady it also lets you reveal again. Each spent ember goes out in the tray.

deck.Title: Deck of Souls
deck.Short: Each card opens a scene: clue, obstacle, mishap or Grey Lady.
deck.Long: The deck has three blocks with one Grey Lady in each. The player never sees what comes; the Guardian only sees how many cards remain in each block.

gray.Title: Grey Ladies
gray.Short: Three thresholds of tension. Each hardens the story; the third opens the epilogue.
gray.Long: When she appears she asks for her price (Resolve or Spirit) and raises obstacle difficulty by 1.

number.Title: Number card
number.Short: 1 to 10. Match or beat the difficulty to overcome the obstacle.
number.Long: What adds up: the card, +2 if you spent Resolve before revealing, and +1 if you push afterwards.

spend.Title: Spend before revealing
spend.Short: One Resolve: +2 to the card you are about to reveal.

push.Title: Push
push.Short: Only if you are 1 short: one Resolve turns it into a success.

reroll.Title: Reveal again
reroll.Short: From the second Lady: one Resolve to reveal another card.

discard.Title: Discard
discard.Short: Cards already played. The top one is the card before the current one.

card-environment.Title: Environment obstacle
card-environment.Short: The physical world turns hostile. Has a difficulty.

card-character.Title: Character obstacle
card-character.Short: A human conflict. Has a difficulty.

card-incident.Title: Mishap
card-incident.Short: Something changes, breaks or is lost. No test.

card-gray.Title: Grey Lady
card-gray.Short: Tension takes a step. She asks for her price.

diary.Title: Diary
diary.Short: Scenes are noted by themselves; you write what the protagonist felt.

history.Title: Chronicle
history.Short: A structured record of everything that happened, to rebuild the session.

truths.Title: Truths
truths.Short: What the protagonist claims. The story may cast doubt on it.
truths.Long: Established, doubtful, contradicted, reinterpreted, pending revelation or resolved. It is not about catching the player out: it is about finding which story they were telling themselves.

memories.Title: Memories
memories.Short: Questions and answers about the past. They can be locked or contradict each other.

guardian.Title: Guardian
guardian.Short: Compact game control: deck, scene, resources and record.

library.Title: Library
library.Short: Scenarios to play, edit, duplicate or import.

safety.Title: Safety
safety.Short: Pause, Veil and X-Card. Anonymous and immediate.

access.Title: Accessibility
access.Short: Text size, contrast, motion and sound.

blocks.Title: Deck blocks
blocks.Short: Cards left in each third and whether its Lady is still inside. Never which card.

split.Title: Split
split.Short: Ten points between Spirit and Resolve, at least 3 each. A scenario may change it.

traits.Title: Traits
traits.Short: Four words or phrases that define the protagonist and spark ideas.

objects.Title: Objects
objects.Short: What they carry. Starred ones matter to the story.

bonds.Title: Bonds
bonds.Short: People who matter: who, what binds you, what parts you.
